text: Mark 2026-10-20: defer actually registering urn:jmap; use (squat) it for now. chat-00 IANA section 'The urn:jmap Namespace' states it is unregistered, registration (RFC 8141) deferred, no IANA action; keeps syntax/assignment/uniqueness rules. Before any future RFC 8141 registration: object URNs (urn:jmap:<type>:<acct>:<id>) are unique only per server, which RFC 8141 experts will likely challenge (would need an issuer/server component).
